<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex074012025-11-2510-59-48" status="reviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"> <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (199b5-199b8)"/>
        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4663"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3706">shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi <expan>bstan bcos</expan> mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan</rs> gyi rnam bshad legs par bshad pa rin po che'i snang ba</rs> zhes bya ba | 
        <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6409">'gro ba'i mgon <lb n="199b7"/> po zhang rin po che</rs>'i bu chen ¦ 
      <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8391">bla ma grub thob ti shri ras pa</rs>'i dbon po sngags mtshan nyid kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3929">dge ba'i <expan>bshes gnyen</expan> kun dga' rgyal mtshan</rs> zhes bya bas snyim pa me tog dang bcas nas yang dang yang du gsol <lb n="199b8"/> ba btab pa'i ngor | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams</rs> kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir ¦ 
      yongs 'dzin gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dka' 4 'dzin pa la stod<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4075"> pa rgyal ba bzang po</rs>s kyang dang dngos cher × byas nas bskul byed <note type="gloss">dang sdeb sbyor </note> kyi rkyen sbyar te ° bde <note type="translation">At the request of the spiritual friend Kun dga' rgyal mtshan, who possesses numerous qualities of mantra and philosophical learning, a nephew of the accomplished master Ti Shri Res pa and a close disciple of the protector of beings Zhang Rin po che, who repeatedly made requests with palms joined together with flowers directly [to me]; for the sake of fulfilling the intentions of the glorious and holy masters; the tutor and spiritual friend praised as an upholder of the four [treatises], called rGyal ba bzang po, encouraged, checked, and provided the [material] conditions for this work... </note> </seg></TEI>
